checks.name: convergent_chain_ordering
checks.description: Four stimulated sources drive four intermediates, which converge on one target.
checks.expectation: Every layer spikes and each layer is at least one delay later than the previous.

checks.name: single_edge_attenuation
checks.description: One 300 pA capped edge from a driven source to a resting target.
checks.expectation: The source spikes; the single structural edge alone is below firing threshold.

observed.note: 300 pA through g=10 nS is 30 mV of steady drive but the exponential EPSP peaks well below it; a resting neuron needs temporal summation.

checks.name: convergence_required
checks.description: Four sources each deliver the same 300 pA capped edge to one target.
checks.expectation: Convergent input fires the target while a single edge does not.

checks.name: edge_removal_downstream
checks.description: Delete every intermediate -> target edge, keep everything else.
checks.expectation: Intermediates spike exactly as in the baseline; the target is silent.

checks.name: edge_removal_upstream
checks.description: Delete every source -> intermediate edge.
checks.expectation: Stimulated sources still spike; intermediates and target are silent.

checks.name: weight_reduction_below_recruitment
checks.description: Reduce intermediate -> target counts from 500 to 10 (28 pA per edge).
checks.expectation: Intermediates still fire; the target no longer reaches threshold.

checks.name: weight_monotonicity
checks.description: Intermediate -> target counts 200 (266 pA, uncapped) versus 500 (capped at 300 pA).
checks.expectation: The stronger capped baseline does not fire the target later than the weaker uncapped input.

checks.name: cap_saturation_equivalence
checks.description: Counts 240 and 5000 both exceed the 300 pA cap.
checks.expectation: Spike trains are bit-identical because both weights saturate at the cap.

checks.name: direction_reversal
checks.description: Reverse every intermediate -> target edge to target -> intermediate.
checks.expectation: Intermediates still fire from the sources; the unstimulated target is silent.

checks.name: inhibitory_only_target_silent
checks.description: Label all four intermediates inhibitory; keep identical structure and drive.
checks.expectation: Intermediates spike but deliver inhibition; the target does not fire.

checks.name: inhibitory_mixed_reduces_target
checks.description: Make one of the four converging intermediates inhibitory.
checks.expectation: The target fires no earlier and no more often than the all-excitatory baseline; inhibitory current is present.

checks.name: unknown_sign_excluded
checks.description: Leave the intermediates unannotated so their edges have unknown sign.
checks.expectation: Intermediates spike; every edge into the target carries zero weight; target silent.

checks.name: predicted_only_excluded
checks.description: Intermediates have predicted but no verified transmitter, under the primary policy.
checks.expectation: Predicted labels are not part of the primary policy; the target is silent.

checks.name: predicted_fallback_enables_propagation
checks.description: Same labels, predicted fallback enabled as a declared sensitivity condition.
checks.expectation: The target now fires, which shows the fallback changes results and must be reported as a sensitivity.

checks.name: no_stimulation_silence
checks.description: Identical network with no stimulation and no noise.
checks.expectation: No neuron spikes.

checks.name: current_injection_threshold
checks.description: Inject 100 pA and 300 pA into a single isolated neuron.
checks.expectation: 100 pA is below the 150 pA rheobase and does not fire; 300 pA does.

checks.name: delay_quantisation
checks.description: Measure the shortest source -> intermediate latency on the chain.
checks.expectation: Latency is at least the 1.0 ms configured axonal delay.

checks.name: refractory_interval
checks.description: Drive one neuron at 5000 pA for 30 ms.
checks.expectation: Every inter-spike interval is at least the 2 ms refractory period.

checks.name: isolated_nodes_silent
checks.description: Add three isolated nodes to a small driven chain.
checks.expectation: Only the connected neurons spike; isolated nodes stay silent.

checks.name: deterministic_repeat
checks.description: Run the same noisy chain twice with seed 7 and once with seed 8.
checks.expectation: The two seed-7 runs are bit-identical; the seed-8 run differs.

full_banc_smoke.selection: highest_out_degree: 64 nodes with the largest structural out-degree at threshold 5, ties broken by ascending node index; chosen before any simulation output was inspected

limitations: Toy graphs are synthetic and use the same neuron and synapse models as the full graph; they test implementation, not biology.
A structural edge under the primary weight policy is insufficient to fire a resting neuron; propagation in the full graph depends on convergence.
The single smoke test demonstrates that a seeded, sparse full-graph simulation runs and is reproducible; it is not evidence of physiological propagation.
